campaign_name: PR-BR — Independent 10-Turn Synthetic Smoke After Continuation 20
purpose: Independent 10-turn playability smoke of the product as it exists after Continuation 20. No behavior changes. No repair. No 4x10 gate. PR-BR remains open.
executive_summary: One isolated frontier-gate session, ten gameplay turns, no product edits. Final manual PASS 8/10. Initial manual PASS 7/10. Contracts: 5 correct, 3 partial, 2 incorrect. Accepted text matched emitted text on all 10 turns. Unsupported authoritative facts emitted: 0. Incidental bindings: 0. Stale-interlocutor fallbacks: 0. Consequential unsupported entities: 0. Rejected-response commits: 0. Two manual failures, different mechanisms, each once: a JSON document sealed as a hard-valid reply, and a leading-clause act that dropped the player's questions. Authority watchlist repeated incidental misclassification: NO. READINESS: READY FOR FULL 4x10 SYNTHETIC GATE. The gate was not run. HUMAN PLAYTEST: NOT AUTHORIZED. PR-BR: STILL OPEN. decisions_requiring_human_review: Readiness judgment is READY FOR FULL 4x10 SYNTHETIC GATE despite contract correctness of 5/10, because manual play is 8/10 and the critical architectural counters are zero. A reviewer may instead treat the two contract misses as a narrow defect and hold the gate.
Do not start a focused continuation solely for the two imperfect turns unless external review rejects that judgment.
PR-BR remains open. Do not start PR-BS. Do not run the 4x10 gate in this cycle. Human playtest is not authorized.

campaign_specific: Turn 8 emitted a JSON document and hard validation sealed it.
Turn 9 committed only 'I follow their glance.' and did not answer the questions.
Turn 5's contract stayed an unresolved clarification on the guard, while the accepted prose did read the board.

does_not_prove: Does not prove 4x10 synthetic-gate health. The gate was not run.
Does not prove contract correctness at the strong-evidence bar of 8/10.
Does not authorize a human playtest.
Does not prove the authority classifier never misses a consequential sentence. It shows no repeated incidental-bucket family in this session.
recommended_next_step: External review. If the readiness judgment stands, the next cycle may run the full 4x10 synthetic gate. Do not run it from this cycle. Do not close PR-BR. Do not start PR-BS. Do not playtest with a human.
